verdict.rationale: Skills themselves are loaded by the model when it judges them relevant, which is not a deterministic rule-on-event mechanism. The adjacent plugin system can bundle hooks alongside skills (docs-6, docs-70), and Agent SDK hooks can block operations before they execute (docs-91), which hints at event-triggered rules. That evidence is only a glancing mention. Separately, users report that relevance-based skill auto-invocation is hit-or-miss (comm-12, comm-14), which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: documentation of the hook event types and rule definitions, examples of triggering skill actions automatically on events, and independent hands-on confirmation that event-driven automation works reliably.
